full_text_en:
Li Xiaoping et al. (eight persons) — case of intentional injury

Promulgated by the Supreme People's Court Document No. 20 (2001)

Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China

Criminal Ruling

(2000) Xing Fu Zi No. 141

Defendant Li Xiaoping, male, born on November 26, 1949, Han ethnicity, born in Handan, Hebei Province, college degree, formerly General Manager of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd. in Guangdong Province, residing at Room 902, No. 8, Sibei Xinjie, Dongshan District, Guangzhou. Arrested on April 10, 1998. Released on bail pending trial on March 5, 1999 due to illness.

Defendant Jing Zhaowei, male, born on April 4, 1968, Han ethnicity, born in Wuyang County, Henan Province, junior high school education, formerly electrician of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 9, 1998. Currently in custody.

Defendant Zhang Shukai, male, born on November 1, 1972, Han ethnicity, born in Yancheng County, Henan Province, junior high school education, formerly squad leader of the filling unit of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 9, 1998. Currently in custody.

Defendant Liu Shaowei, male, born on May 13, 1979, Han ethnicity, born in Wuyang County, Henan Province, junior high school education, formerly packer of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 9, 1998. Currently in custody.

Defendant Wang Yaosheng, male, born on April 6, 1977, Han ethnicity, born in Wuyang County, Henan Province, junior high school education, formerly deputy squad leader of the security team of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 9, 1998. Currently in custody.

Defendant Chi Wenjun, male, born on July 8, 1976, Han ethnicity, born in Wuyang County, Henan Province, junior high school education, formerly packer of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 10, 1998. Currently in custody.

Defendant He Hongtao, male, born on February 4, 1970, Han ethnicity, born in Wuyang County, Henan Province, junior high school education, formerly squad leader of the security team of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 9, 1998. Currently in custody.

Defendant Zhang Xuejun, male, born on December 26, 1973, Han ethnicity, born in Linli County, Hunan Province, junior high school education, formerly security guard of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., residing in the company dormitory. Arrested on April 10, 1998. Currently in custody.

The Intermediate People's Court of Zhongshan City, Guangdong Province, after hearing the case initiated by the People's Procuratorate of Zhongshan City against the defendants Li Xiaoping, Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Liu Shaowei, He Hongtao, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, and Zhang Xuejun for the crime of intentional injury, rendered a criminal judgment on August 11, 1998, with the case number (1998) Zhong Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 28, finding the defendants guilty of intentional injury. It sentenced Li Xiaoping, Wang Yaosheng, and Zhang Shukai each to 11 years' imprisonment and deprivation of political rights for three years; and sentenced Liu Shaowei, He Hongtao, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, and Zhang Xuejun each to 10 years' imprisonment and deprivation of political rights for three years. After the judgment was announced, Li Xiaoping, Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Liu Shaowei, Jing Zhaowei, and Chi Wenjun appealed; He Hongtao and Zhang Xuejun accepted the judgment and did not appeal. The Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province, on March 22, 2000, with case number (1999) Yue Gao Xing Zhong Zi No. 74, issued a criminal judgment setting aside the original judgment. It sentenced Wang Yaosheng and Zhang Shukai each to 6 years' imprisonment; sentenced Liu Shaowei, He Hongtao, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, and Zhang Xuejun each to 5 years' imprisonment; and sentenced Li Xiaoping to 3 years' imprisonment, all for intentional injury with sentences below the statutory punishment, and submitted the case to this Court for approval. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and conducted a review of the case. The review has now concluded.

The review established: At around 19:00 on March 2, 1998, while passing by the main gate of Zhongshan Like Cordyceps Products Co., Ltd., the defendant Liu Shaowei and Wang Guanghui (co-defendant, already sentenced) saw a female worker of the factory, Guo XX, arguing with the victim Jiang Liangli. They approached to question them and struck Jiang Liangli, leading to a mutual fight. Subsequently, upon hearing the commotion, the defendants Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Jing Zhaowei, and Zhang Xuejun arrived carrying iron water pipes and other tools and joined in beating Jiang Liangli and others, forcing Jiang Liangli to flee into the courtyard of a nearby military unit (Unit 781). At that time, the defendants He Hongtao and Chi Wenjun also arrived and joined the above defendants in searching for and beating Jiang Liangli, and together they escorted Jiang Liangli toward the Cordyceps Products Company. Along the way, they encountered Li Jian, Ou Hai, and others who had come to rescue Jiang Liangli. Jiang Liangli took the opportunity to break free, and the above defendants retreated into the company compound. Thereafter, Jiang Liangli, Li Jian, and others gathered in front of the Cordyceps Company, demanding that the assailants be handed over. The two sides argued and, separated by an electric sliding gate, threw and jabbed at each other with iron water pipes, wooden sticks, and other tools, forming a standoff. During this time, the Chief Financial Officer of the Cordyceps Company, Yao Keyu, and Jiang Liangli's brother-in-law, Zou Jingcai, both tried to persuade the parties to stop the fight but to no avail. Upon learning of the situation, the defendant Li Xiaoping arrived at the scene and urged calm, but to no effect. When Jiang Liangli and others violently slammed the gate and smashed a bicycle parked outside the gate, Li Xiaoping ordered the company's employees to rush out and fight them and to capture Jiang Liangli and the others. Immediately, dozens of employees of the Cordyceps Company, armed with iron water pipes, wooden sticks, and other tools, rushed out of the gate and chased Jiang Liangli, Ou Hai, and others who were fleeing. Ou Hai was injured but escaped. When Jiang Liangli was about 50 meters from the company gate, he was grabbed by He Hongtao, who was pursuing him. He Hongtao, together with Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Liu Shaowei, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, Zhang Xuejun, and Wang Guanghui, who subsequently arrived, jointly beat Jiang Liangli using iron water pipes, wooden sticks, and their fists and feet, causing him to fall to the ground. Jiang Liangli died after being sent to the hospital despite emergency rescue. Forensic examination confirmed that Jiang Liangli died of hemorrhagic shock due to splenic rupture caused by a blunt force blow to his left waist; Ou Hai suffered minor injuries.

After the incident, the Cordyceps Company paid RMB 100,000 in compensation to Jiang Liangli's relatives, and the defendant Li Xiaoping personally paid an additional RMB 50,000 to Jiang Liangli's relatives.

The above facts are confirmed by the statement of the victim Ou Hai, the forensic examination conclusion, the seized tools, witness testimonies, and the confessions of the co-defendants. The defendants Li Xiaoping, Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Liu Shaowei, He Hongtao, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, and Zhang Xuejun also confessed, which is sufficient for identification.

This Court holds: The defendants Li Xiaoping, Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Liu Shaowei, He Hongtao, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, and Zhang Xuejun unlawfully and intentionally inflicted harm on another person's body, causing death and minor injuries. Their acts have constituted the crime of intentional injury, with serious consequences, and they should all be punished according to law. The facts of the crime as found in the judgments of the first and second instance courts are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the conviction is correct. The trial procedures were lawful. However, the second instance court's determination that the victim's side had obvious fault in the origin of the case and that the defendant Li Xiaoping had called the police during the incident lacks factual basis. The second instance court's reduction of the sentences for the defendants Li Xiaoping, Wang Yaosheng, Zhang Shukai, Liu Shaowei, He Hongtao, Jing Zhaowei, Chi Wenjun, and Zhang Xuejun to below the statutory punishment constitutes an improper sentencing discretion and should be corrected. Pursuant to Article 270 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

1. The criminal judgment of the Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province, (1999) Yue Gao Xing Zhong Zi No. 74, is set aside;

2. The case is remanded to the Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province for a new trial.

This ruling shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Du Weifu

Judge: Ren Xiancheng

Judge: Zhou Feng

February 17, 2001

Court Clerk: Song Chuxiao
